evidence_class: analytical research preflight; not CI qualification and not production evidence
comparison: F-AHL01 direct theta versus transformed logit(Se), with log(C) and log(K) unchanged
finding: The physically transformed retention coordinate reduces support materially for three of four materials and modestly for B12 while preserving all preregistered error limits.
interpretation: Representation coordinate is a stronger lever than simply raising interpolation order in this preflight. This supports investigating a compact transformed hybrid representation before any end-to-end Richards integration.
nonclaims: No end-to-end hydrological equivalence is established.
No claim is made outside the four tested unimodal materials and the smooth h <= Hcrit core.
next_gate: Measure lookup-search plus reconstruction cost against direct constitutive evaluation and fixed-table alternatives; independently validate dense off-grid errors before Richards replay.
